item.description:
PalMeet 0.2.8

  • Fixed a crash when the microphone changed during a recording (for example an iPhone Continuity microphone connecting or dropping). PalMeet now waits for the change to settle and restarts the microphone cleanly.

PalMeet 0.2.7

  • Summaries cross the screenshots with the transcript: what was on screen is read in at the moment it appeared (ticket titles, links, file names, names spelled right), without repeating what was already shown.
  • The screenshots sent to the AI are the ones that match what people were talking about, spread over the meeting.
  • Each topic and decision in summary.md shows the screenshot that illustrates it, right under it.
  • To redo an older meeting's summary: Review → Regenerate summary.

PalMeet 0.2.6

  • Google Meet: speakers are named from the speaking highlight on their tile (the moving voice bars), even with captions off. Update the PalMeet extension in Chrome (it reloads itself) to get this.
  • Meet's "Are you talking? Your mic is off." is no longer read as a person called "Are you". Voices learned under such names are removed.
  • Your own tile is ignored when naming remote speakers, and captions win over the highlight.
  • Review → Regenerate → "Transcribe again from the audio" redoes a meeting's transcript and summary.
